title: Uporny, the stubborn tiger
caption:
His name means 'stubborn'. It fits.

Uporny's release was run by the Khabarovsk hunting department's tiger-conflict team with the Amur Tiger Center and WWF-Russia, and his collar let researchers follow him for most of two years.

Source: WWF Tigers Alive; Amur Tiger Center.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
